Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association (inside Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry) will be open April 29 (Wed, holiday) through May 5 (Tue, holiday), Reiwa 8. Since it will also be open on May 3 (Sun, holiday), it will be closed on May 6 (Wed) as a compensatory holiday. During this period, services such as manhole card distribution and Eagle Bus pass purchases will not be available.

Hanno Station Tourist Information Center "Pratt Hanno" (TEL 042-978-9111) will operate as usual, 9:00–17:00.
